name: How much does it cost to install new kitchen cabinets and countertops?

mainEntity.name: How much does it cost to install new kitchen cabinets and countertops?

acceptedAnswer.text: The cost for new kitchen cabinets and countertops can range widely, typically from $10,000 to $50,000 or more. This price depends on several factors, including the size of your kitchen, the type of cabinets (stock, semi-custom, or custom), material choices for countertops (e.g., laminate, quartz, granite, marble), and any structural modifications. Installation labor costs are also a significant component. We provide a detailed, itemized quote after an on-site consultation to accurately assess your specific needs and preferences.
acceptedAnswer.description: Costs for kitchen cabinets and countertops vary widely, usually from $10,000 to $50,000+, based on kitchen size, material choices, and cabinet type.
